本预发布条款说明公开产品网站及演示申请表的使用方式，不适用于采购工作区的试点、试: These prerelease terms describe use of the public product website and demo request form. They do not apply to pilots, trials, or production deployments of the procurement workspace.
商业平台访问必须另行签署协议，约定范围、费用、服务等级、数据保护、保密、支持、责: Commercial platform access requires a separate signed agreement covering scope, fees, service levels, data protection, confidentiality, support, liability, and termination.
本产品仍处于 V1 主动验证阶段，尚不代表已经普遍可用。截图用于说明预期交互模型: The product is still undergoing active V1 validation and is not generally available. Screenshots illustrate the intended interaction model. Business records in authenticated workspaces come from connected tenant systems and are not generated from screenshots.
具名身份、已发布的 SLA 策略、已核验的采购路径证据以及真实的采购订单到收货单: Named identities, published SLA policies, verified procurement route evidence, and a real purchase-order-to-goods-receipt lifecycle remain prerequisites for production activation.
您可以使用公开页面评估产品、在内部分享页面用于该项评估，并使用您有权提供的信息提: You may use the public pages to evaluate the product, share them internally for that evaluation, and submit a genuine demo request using information you are authorized to provide.
已登录工作区仅限部署负责人授权的账号及租户数据访问。: Authenticated workspaces are restricted to accounts and tenant data access authorized by the deployment owner.
您不得尝试未经授权的访问、跨越租户边界、植入恶意软件、使接口过载、绕过审批或连接: You must not attempt unauthorized access, cross tenant boundaries, introduce malware, overload APIs, bypass approval or connector gates, submit another person's information without authorization, or misrepresent system recommendations as approved business decisions.
供应商附件和消息属于不可信输入，不得用于指示系统执行获批采购工作流以外的操作。: Supplier attachments and messages are untrusted inputs and must not be used to instruct the system to act outside approved procurement workflows.
提交演示表单仅构成咨询。API 接受请求仅表示已校验的申请及审计事件已持久化；这: Submitting the demo form constitutes an inquiry only. API acceptance means only that the validated request and audit event have been persisted. 任何范围、时间、价格或生产承诺均须另行书面约定。: Any commitment on scope, timing, pricing, or production requires a separate written agreement.
客户组织仍须对采购授权、供应商关系、合法指令、业务规则、获批用户以及提供给平台的: Customer organizations remain responsible for procurement authorization, supplier relationships, lawful instructions, business rules, approved users, and the accuracy of ERP and communication data provided to the platform.
对于任何试点或生产部署，已签署的平台协议优先于本网站内容。: For any pilot or production deployment, the signed platform agreement takes precedence over this website.

界面标签或草稿不能证明邮件已经发送、ERP 已经更新或阶段已经完成。只有已配置连: Interface labels and drafts do not prove that an email was sent, ERP was updated, or a stage was completed. The system confirms these outcomes only after a configured connector returns a verifiable receipt recorded in the audit trail.

Readywork 公开视觉素材为自有内容。软件库和服务依照第三方组件许可清单审: SupplySentry owns its public visual assets. Libraries and services are reviewed against the third-party component license inventory. Components without production usage rights must not be included in commercial releases.
公开网站和预发布工作区可能变更、暂停或存在缺陷。本页不构成对生产可用时间、响应时: The public website and prerelease workspace may change, be suspended, or contain defects. This page does not guarantee production uptime, response times, integrations, or business outcomes.

Readywork 采购执行及公开演示申请表的预发布隐私说明。: Prerelease privacy notice for SupplySentry Procurement Execution and its public demo request form.
本说明适用于公开产品网站和演示申请表，以及由本部署运行、需要登录的采购执行工作区: This notice applies to the public product website and demo request form, and to the authenticated procurement execution workspace operated by this deployment.
本产品仍处于受监督的 V1 验证阶段。最终的数据控制者、处理者、签约实体和正式隐: The product remains in supervised V1 validation. The final data controller, processor, contracting entity, and formal privacy contact have not yet been approved for commercial release.
对于生产环境客户，客户组织应控制其采购订单、供应商联系人、往来通信和运营决策。部: For production customers, the customer organization should control its purchase orders, supplier contacts, communications, and operational decisions. The deployment operator processes these records only for configured procurement workflows under the final signed customer agreement.
收到消息的供应商应向消息中标明的采购组织提出数据请求。在具名专业采购身份完成配置: Suppliers receiving messages should direct data requests to the procurement organization identified in the message. External messages remain blocked until a named professional procurement identity has been configured and verified.
演示表单要求填写姓名、工作邮箱和公司；职位、国家／地区、ERP、每月采购订单量和: The demo form requires a name, work email, and company. Role, country or region, ERP, monthly purchase order volume, and pilot notes are optional. The server rejects requests that populate the hidden anti-bot field.
获接受的申请会经过校验，以稳定的申请编号存入 SQLite，并生成只追加的提交事: Accepted requests are validated and stored in SQLite with a stable request ID, along with an append-only submission event. Submitting a request does not automatically send email, write to a CRM, or start procurement workflows.
已登录工作区可能处理采购订单及行项目、供应商主数据和联系人、收发邮件证据、附件、: Authenticated workspaces may process purchase orders and line items, supplier master data and contacts, inbound and outbound email evidence, attachments, confirmations, approvals, production progress, dispatch and receipt records, SLA assessments, connector receipts, notifications, and audit events.
记录按租户隔离。本产品不会有意向其他租户暴露某一租户的采购记录；未经身份验证的业: Records are isolated by tenant. The product does not intentionally expose one tenant's procurement records to other tenants. Unauthenticated business API requests are rejected.
公开页面不要求应用会话。已登录工作区使用严格必要的 HttpOnly、SameS: Public pages do not require an application session. Authenticated workspaces use strictly necessary HttpOnly, SameSite session cookies. Tokens are not stored in browser localStorage.
当前 Console 源码不包含分析或广告 SDK。公开标识从 Readywor: The current Console source contains no analytics or advertising SDKs. Public marks are served from SupplySentry-owned local paths or rendered as local React visuals. Product pages do not request media from reference products. Routine server and connector logs may include request times, statuses, and technical diagnostics.
AI 和确定性规则可能提取供应商回复、识别缺失事实、起草催办并建议操作。重大差异: AI and deterministic rules may extract supplier replies, identify missing facts, draft follow-ups, and recommend actions. Major variances, high-risk decisions, and actions beyond configured permissions still require human approval.
投入生产前，模型提供方、运行区域、数据使用条款和保留政策必须在部署配置及客户协议: Before production, the model provider, operating region, data-use terms, and retention policy must be fixed in the deployment configuration and customer agreement. This prerelease page makes no promises about providers or training policies that have not been configured and verified.
数据只能与为租户明确配置的连接器交换，例如电子邮件、ERP/Odoo、工作流运行: Data may be exchanged only with connectors explicitly configured for the tenant, such as email, ERP/Odoo, workflow runtimes, object storage, malware scanning, or approved model runtimes. Connector actions are recorded as successful only after a real receipt is returned.
最终分处理者清单、托管位置和跨境传输机制仍是商业上线前置条件，将在部署架构和合同: The final subprocessor list, hosting locations, and cross-border transfer mechanisms remain prerequisites for commercial launch and will be published after the deployment architecture and contracts are approved.
已经实现的控制包括身份验证、角色检查、租户隔离、连接器凭据加密、附件类型和恶意软: Implemented controls include authentication, role checks, tenant isolation, encrypted connector credentials, attachment type and malware gates, idempotency, optimistic version control, append-only events, and auditable receipts for external actions.
任何系统都无法完全消除风险。生产启用还要求连接器健康、未解决死信为零、安全事件已: No system can eliminate all risk. Production activation also requires healthy connectors, no unresolved dead letters, reviewed security events, and verified recovery procedures.
当前会保留采购和审计记录，以支持追溯与恢复。具有约束力的保留期限、删除流程、诉讼: Procurement and audit records are currently retained to support traceability and recovery. Binding retention periods, deletion processes, legal holds, and procedures for responding to data subject requests have not yet been approved.
商业上线前，必须按数据类别记录这些期限和程序，并与客户作为控制者的义务、ERP: Before commercial launch, these periods and procedures must be documented by data category and aligned with the customer's obligations as controller, ERP records, and signed agreements.
预发布评估期间，请将隐私问题发送给提供访问权限的部署负责人。只有在运营实体确认后: During prerelease evaluation, direct privacy questions to the deployment owner who provided access. A formal public privacy contact address will be added only after the operating entity is confirmed.
数据收集、连接器、AI 提供方或保留政策发生重大变更时，应在启用受影响的生产能力: If data collection, connectors, AI providers, or retention policies change materially, this page and its effective date should be updated before the affected production capabilities are enabled.
